about: VerseUp's attribution registry. Every third-party text, dataset, font and library the app ships is listed here once; the Attributions & Licences page is generated from this file, and :pipeline:buildStudy copies dataset entries into study.db. Tests fail when a bundled source has no entry or an entry is missing a required field.

resources.name: King James Version (1769 standard text)
resources.author: Translated 1611; Blayney standard text 1769. Electronic edition by eBible.org
resources.description: The Bible text VerseUp shows, with the translators' italics and the words of Jesus.
resources.copyright: Public domain. In the United Kingdom the King James Version is under a Crown patent held by Cambridge University Press, Oxford University Press and Collins.
resources.attribution: King James Version (1769). Public domain. Source: eBible.org.
resources.modifications: Whitespace normalised; paragraph and section breaks added for reading. The words are unchanged.

resources.name: World English Bible paragraph positions
resources.author: eBible.org
resources.description: Where paragraphs start, used to break the KJV into readable cards. Only positions are used, no WEB text.
resources.attribution: Paragraph positions from the World English Bible (public domain), eBible.org.

resources.name: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary
resources.author: James Strong, LL.D., S.T.D. (1894). XML edition corrected by David Troidl and David Instone-Brewer, published by Open Scriptures
resources.description: A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible, with their Renderings in the King James Version: headwords, transliterations, pronunciations, derivations, definitions and KJV renderings for H1-H8674.
resources.attribution: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary (1894), public domain. XML edition: Open Scriptures (github.com/openscriptures/strongs).
resources.modifications: Only Strong's own fields are used. The outline definitions, Theological Wordbook (TWOT) numbers and Greek equivalents in the same file come from other works and are not included.

resources.name: Strong's Greek Dictionary
resources.author: James Strong, S.T.D., LL.D. (1890). XML edition by Ulrik Petersen, published by Open Scriptures
resources.description: Dictionary of Greek Words taken from Strong's Exhaustive Concordance: headwords, transliterations, pronunciations, derivations, definitions and KJV renderings for G1-G5624.
resources.attribution: Strong's Greek Dictionary (1890), public domain. XML edition 1.4 by Ulrik Petersen (ulrikp.org), via Open Scriptures.
resources.modifications: Reformatted into VerseUp's study database; text unchanged.

resources.description: The Hebrew and Aramaic Old Testament (Leningrad Codex, with the scribes' Qere corrections), word by word, with transliteration, STEP's English translation, disambiguated Strong's numbers and ETCBC-based grammar.
